# Costikyan

> > Costikyan provides professional rug restoration, repair, cleaning, and preservation services for antique oriental and Persian rugs in the Tri-State Area.

Costikyan specializes in comprehensive rug care including reweaving, recoloring, fringe repair, moth treatment, pest remediation, and custom padding solutions. Their services preserve valuable antique textiles and natural fiber rugs through expert craftsmanship and specialized treatments.

## Key Topics

- Rug restoration and repair
- Antique oriental and Persian rugs
- Moth treatment and pest remediation
- Reweaving and recoloring
- Fringe repair
- Rug cleaning services
- Rug pads (Durahold, Zip Grip)
- Natural fiber rugs
- Carpet padding options
- Antique rug preservation
- Moth damage repair
- Tri-State Area services
- Area rug care
